title: When Reviews Are Scarce: Structure-Aware Review Imputation for Recommendation in Realistic Sparse Review Settings
abstract: arXiv:2508.01128v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Textual reviews enrich recommender systems with fine-grained preference signals and enhanced explainability. However, in real-world scenarios, users rarely leave reviews, resulting in severe sparsity that undermines the effectiveness of review-aware recommenders under partial observability. A natural remedy is to synthesize the missing reviews to restore the textual signal these recommenders rely on. Yet, conventional imputation techniques, such as matrix completion and LLM-based augmentation, either lose contextualized semantics by embedding texts into vectors or overlook structural dependencies on the user-item graph. To address these shortcomings, we propose TWISTER (ToWards Imputation on Sparsity with Textual Edge Graph Representation), a unified framework for sparse-text recommendation that synthesizes missing reviews by jointly modeling semantic and structural signals. translated_title: 当评论稀缺时：现实稀疏评论场景下感知结构的评论补全推荐方法
translated_abstract: 文本评论为推荐系统提供了细粒度的偏好信号和更强的可解释性。然而，在现实场景中，用户很少留下评论，导致严重的稀疏性，削弱了部分可观测条件下评论感知推荐器的有效性。一个自然的补救方法是合成缺失的评论，以恢复这些推荐器所依赖的文本信号。然而，传统的补全技术，如矩阵补全和基于大语言模型的增强方法，要么在将文本嵌入为向量时丢失上下文语义，要么忽视了用户-物品图上的结构依赖关系。为了解决这些缺陷，我们提出了TWISTER（ToWards Imputation on Sparsity with Textual Edge Graph Representation），这是一个用于稀疏文本推荐的统一框架，通过联合建模语义信号和结构信号来合成缺失评论。具体而言，我们将用户-物品交互表示为……
tldr: 提出TWISTER统一框架，通过在文本边图上联合建模语义与结构信号来合成缺失评论，从而在用户很少写评论的现实稀疏场景下提升评论感知推荐系统的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TWISTER, a unified framework that synthesizes missing reviews by jointly modeling semantic and structural signals on a textual-edge user-item graph, improving review-aware recommendation in realistic sparse review settings.
